notes:
v1.0.47 - Update pipeline self-healing (fixes the v1.0.46 failed update).

1) The v1.0.46 update showed "failed": its manifest url still pointed at the
1.0.45 installer while version/sha256 described 1.0.46, so the downloaded
file failed checksum verification (the launcher correctly refused it). The
manifest is corrected; if you saw the failure, check for updates again.
2) Updater hardening: on a checksum mismatch the launcher now refetches the
manifest fresh and retries the download once (covers fixed-just-now manifests
and stale CDN copies). Only a still-mismatching manifest reports a failure.
3) Release tooling now derives the manifest url from the version number, so
this class of mismatch cannot be generated again.
